presence.label: Presence
presence.hint: Back-to-back dialogue bars per scene (A ◀ cell ▶ B)

mutual.label: Mutual scenes
mutual.hint: Only scenes where BOTH of the pair appear — hides solo scenes too

empty.label: Empty nodes
empty.hint: Show the time-gap ghosts (scenes where neither of the pair appears); off hides them

warmth.label: Warmth
warmth.hint: Replace the spine with the warmth trajectory (Warm↔Cold axis)

events.label: Events
events.hint: Shift markers flanking each scene; click for the detail

pov.label: POV
pov.hint: Glow each character's POV scenes (authored, else the dominant speaker)

silent.label: Silent presence
silent.hint: Also show present-but-silent cast (the prose-read room), not just speakers

observed.label: Observed
observed.hint: Ghost marks where ANALYSIS saw this topic move/reveal with no declared checkpoint — the unplanned-reveal diff

irony.label: Irony
irony.hint: Dramatic-irony bands from custody topics — the reader knows what this fighter doesn't (band on the unknowing side)
